rationale: The registry revision is split into operation-month and MW revision candidates in the expanded manifest.
The realized-delivery observation maps to the manifest capacity, operating MW, and operation-month candidates.
The registry cancellation flag is the source-specific representation of the manifest cancellation candidate.
The queue observation contains both position and age and is constrained by the interconnection obligation.
Remaining performance is the reported contract balance that feeds backlog level and backlog-to-cash-flow timing.
The manifest has no change-order node, so these targets record the closest delivery revision and obligation candidates without claiming identity.
The commitment measure is a buyer-side capacity input, while the manifest currently represents its physical capacity and site consequences.
The balancing-authority demand series belongs to the declared grid operations dataset and informs peak-load growth.
The balancing-authority generation series belongs to the declared grid operations dataset and informs generation mix.
Drought severity is an upstream control for the manifest cooling-constraint candidate, not the constraint itself.
The existing compute rental measurement and manifest rental-price candidate describe the same listed rental observable.
The manifest has a rental-price candidate but does not yet distinguish executed transactions from listed prices.
No manifest node represents executable power settlement-point price, and congestion spread is not a safe substitute.
The registry gas price series is the manifest gas-price factor candidate.
The registry copper price series is the manifest copper-price factor candidate.
The registry uranium price series is the manifest uranium-price factor candidate.
The registry ten-year Treasury rate is the manifest ten-year-rate factor candidate.
The buildout basket needs issuer membership and supplier exposure, which the manifest represents through these candidate nodes.
The scarcity basket needs utility and sector exposure plus issuer identity, which are separate manifest candidates.
The registry disclosure event is the manifest material-agreement event candidate.
The registry funding-rate series is the declared manifest positioning funding-rate feature.
The registry implied-move series is the manifest pre-event implied-move feature.
The broad survey share covers more equipment than transformers, so the targets record related candidates without claiming exact coverage.
The manifest represents the index vehicle and forced-flow mechanism but does not yet contain an index-reconstitution flow node.
Dealer hedge demand is represented by option gamma, forced-flow, and open-interest candidates until historical chains are available.
The lease-rate observation needs the manifest lease, site, and capacity candidates, but aggregate disclosures prevent exact unit-rate identity.
The manifest contains credit, obligation, and cash-flow candidates but no project drawdown flow node.
